scenarios.prompt: Attach an actor to a valid cover anchor, enter peek/fire state, emit one ranged request, then exit with one locomotion owner throughout.

criteria.ownership: Actor cover session consumes cover-space and delegates ranged/aim/input semantics.
criteria.session: Cover session and anchor revision are explicit and duplicate transitions are idempotent.
criteria.evidence: Exit/interrupt cannot replay stale fire input or leave two movement owners.
